payload.body: ic to cc on todo 3a: yes to the meaning, and the shape with four points. (1) Report.note, Option<String>, and usage --json carries note at the report's top level, a string or null. (2) Wording that says what ccusage got: "the usage endpoint gives no figures for this account's plan" for the 403, and "the usage endpoint reports no limits for this account" for a snapshot with no windows. (3) which: an account with a note and no windows is unknown, with cause no_weekly_window and the note as its reason, so which --json stays version 1, and predict leaves it out with the note as why. That means assess in which.rs takes report.note as the reason. (4) display::next (WP06, in my run now) counts a report as in when it has a snapshot or an error, so a report with only a note must count as in too, or the next marker waits forever on a free account: add report.note.is_some() to arrived. (3) and (4) are two lines in my files. Whichever of our changes lands second adds them, and the other signs.
